svg.title: With Claude Haiku 5.5, Layout only scores best and costs least
svg.desc: RealKIE invoices, 20 documents × 3 runs: Weighted accuracy: Layout only (recommended) 80% at $22.1 per 1,000 documents, Tables, layout, signatures (preset default) 76% at $69.4 per 1,000 documents, Tables only 80% at $67.0 per 1,000 documents, Tables, layout, signatures, forms 76% at $270 per 1,000 documents; Documents with every field right: Layout only (recommended) 0% at $22.1 per 1,000 documents, Tables, layout, signatures (preset default) 0% at $69.4 per 1,000 documents, Tables only 5% at $67.0 per 1,000 documents, Tables, layout, signatures, forms 0% at $270 per 1,000 documents; Fake-W2 forms, 20 documents × 3 runs: Weighted accuracy: Layout only (recommended) 100% at $7.40 per 1,000 documents, Tables, layout, signatures (preset default) 96% at $18.5 per 1,000 documents, Tables only 93% at $18.5 per 1,000 documents, Tables, layout, signatures, forms 97% at $68.5 per 1,000 documents; Documents with every field right: Layout only (recommended) 82% at $7.40 per 1,000 documents, Tables, layout, signatures (preset default) 55% at $18.5 per 1,000 documents, Tables only 37% at $18.5 per 1,000 documents, Tables, layout, signatures, forms 57% at $68.5 per 1,000 documents; Baseline setup: Amazon Textract with Layout only; holistic classification reading text and page images, single-pass extraction with structured output, and confidence scoring, all on Claude Haiku 5.5, with no escalation to a second scoring model.
